facts.en: Completed a BA in Community Studies at Fictional College B20 in 2026.
facts.zh: 2026 年获虚构学院 B20 社区研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Part-time reception assistant at Fictional Arts Workshop B20, 2025-06 to 2026-04.
facts.zh: 2025-06 至 2026-04，任虚构艺术工作坊 B20 兼职接待助理。

facts.en: Maintained workshop attendance lists and passed registration questions to the coordinator.
facts.zh: 维护工作坊出席名单，并将报名问题转交协调员。

facts.en: Checked registration entries for 8 workshops in 2026-02; no fundraising or programme outcome is attributed.
facts.zh: 2026-02，检查 8 场工作坊的报名记录；不归因任何筹款或项目成效。

facts.en: For a 2026-03 course assignment, drafted an orientation pack for an imaginary volunteer garden project.
facts.zh: 为 2026-03 的课程作业，起草假想志愿者花园项目的入门资料包。

facts.en: The pack contained 4 role descriptions and a draft sign-in sheet; no volunteers were recruited.
facts.zh: 该资料包含 4 份职责说明及签到表草稿；未招募志愿者。

facts.en: Used document templates and spreadsheet sorting for class and reception tasks.
facts.zh: 在课程及接待任务中使用文档模板与电子表格排序。

facts.en: No volunteer safeguarding training, donor database work, or independent programme delivery is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录志愿者安全保障培训、捐赠者数据库工作或独立项目交付经历。
